notes: [P1] brief-conflict: The acceptance criterion says the full suite passes "with no existing test file edited". The diff does edit four existing test files: test/card-buttons.test.js, test/pause-speed.test.js, test/sell.test.js and test/upgrade.test.js. Each edit only pins Math.random to 0 while it imports src/main.js, so the opening round runs on path 1, the path their hard-coded clicks were written for. The edits look unavoidable: the brief requires main.js to open with pickPath(Math.random), so tests that boot main.js and click fixed cells must pin the random draw. The brief's touches list names exactly these files, which suggests the edits were expected. They are minimal and restore the real Math.random in a finally block. I am not counting this as an outcome miss, but the brief contradicts itself here, and someone who owns the brief should accept these edits explicitly.

[P2] scope: pickPath throws a RangeError when random returns a value outside [0, 1). The brief did not ask for this. It is a reasonable guard, since without it createGame would quietly fall back to path 1, and it is tested. It is still extra behaviour beyond the requested PATHS[Math.floor(random() * 5)].
